infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cropvibe uses your camera to capture photos and videos for posts, reels, stories and live sessions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cropvibe uses your microphone for recording videos and participating in live sessions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cropvibe allows you to select photos and videos from your library to share with the farming community.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cropvibe saves media to your device only when you choose to download or save content.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cropvibe can tag posts with your district when you add a location.
